name: Aelnir Student Calculator
seoTitle: Aelnir Student Calculator: GPA, CGPA and grades offline
summary: GPA, CGPA, weighted grades, a scientific calculator and study tools for students. Offline, no account.
tagline: The calculations students actually need, with the working shown. No account, no subscription, no cloud.

features.title: Built for the semester
features.lead: Every non-trivial result has a “How this was calculated” explanation.

items.title: GPA and CGPA
items.body: Configurable grade scales, custom grade points, a projected mode and saved semesters.

items.title: Grades and targets
items.body: Weighted grades and the score you need on the final to reach a target, with impossible targets flagged.

items.title: Attendance
items.body: How many classes you can still miss, or how many in a row you need to recover.

items.title: Scientific calculator
items.body: Degrees or radians, memory, and history you can reuse.

items.title: Maths and units
items.body: Fractions, percentages, ratios, statistics, algebra, geometry and an 11-category unit converter.

items.title: Study planner
items.body: Workload, exam hour allocation, a Pomodoro timer and exam countdown.

strip.label: Includes
strip.text: GPA · CGPA · Weighted grade · Attendance · Scientific · Algebra · Units · Planner

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Correctness is never behind an ad
note.body: Aelnir Student Calculator is free and supported by ads. Results and explanations are never locked, and your data stays on your phone.

studioProof.hard: A custom expression parser and exact fraction arithmetic, with an explanation for every result.
